semantic_observation: User-provided output does not add exclusivity; key_details and caveats explicitly preserve uncertainty about other formats and untested GPU support. This is a qualitative review of this output, not a model-wide score.
limits: Simplified prompt differs from both production prompts; user-run model/config are unreported; one user output and two calls per production prompt cannot establish model ranking or prompt causation. No additional API calls in this comparison.
phase_two_conclusion: Deterministic citation validation verifies provenance/text occurrence, not semantic entailment. Production outputs show supports→only supports under both old and new prompts. User-provided output shows the specific mistake is avoidable in this example, but does not identify whether model, prompt or their interaction caused the difference.
